data.content_ref: inline:SRC_001 names a dependence relation ('depends on SRC_003 by operationalizing the Epistemic Agency probe') but the refutation hook attacks a measurement-validity property of the probe itself (flagged-decoy presence confounded with intelligence), not the dependence link between 0d16ae40c2a5 and SRC_003. No causal mechanism is given for WHY 0d16ae40c2a5 depends on SRC_003 — only that SRC_003 supplies a discriminator. A 'probe supplies a discriminator' is a summary of what SRC_003 contains; the dependence claim needs a stated mechanism (e.g., SRC_003's findings alter the causal path by which 0d16ae40c2a5 distinguishes reliability from compliance), which is absent.
